interpretation: SP500 frozen independent-risk penalty 0.05 strength 0.5 improves validation AR, STD, MDD and Sharpe over the same alpha without penalty; its RankIC improves from 0.03549 to 0.04515.
Adaptive strength 0.5 improves SP500 portfolio metrics over its matched static penalty, with a small RankIC reduction from 0.04604 to 0.04515.
CSI300 penalties reduce volatility but materially reduce return. Stronger adaptive scaling does not dominate the static penalty. Preserve these tradeoffs.
All six matched Top30 loss controls lower validation RankIC and worsen STD/MDD versus mixed loss. Some AR improvements do not imply an overall improvement.
The same configuration is checked across multiple seeds; a single favorable alpha seed is not evidence of stable superiority. No holdout has been opened.
